tools.name: picorn_capabilities
tools.description: List live canvas formats, fonts, layouts, image models, GPU reachability and fair-use limits.

tools.name: picorn_projects_create
tools.description: Create a marketing project that can hold many editor files and imported image assets. Keep the returned workspaceProjectId and workspaceProjectKey together; use them when adding every related file.

tools.name: picorn_projects_inspect
tools.description: List every editor file, imported asset, and the project brand profile with named colors and saved logos or visual references. File entries include their current thumbnail, status, creation URL and canonical /studio/editor?runId=... editorUrl. Always give the user that editorUrl.

tools.name: picorn_projects_update
tools.description: Update the name, description, or named color scheme of a marketing project, then return its complete file, asset, and brand index.

tools.name: picorn_design_image
tools.description: Turn a topic into a finished social image with generated/researched imagery and crisp real typography. Best default for ready-to-share work. Returns an inline preview and public creationUrl.

tools.name: picorn_generate_image
tools.description: Generate a raw image with self-hosted Z-Image Turbo. Returns an inline preview and public creationUrl.

tools.name: picorn_edit_image
tools.description: Transform an existing image with Flux 2 Klein. Returns an inline preview and public creationUrl.

tools.name: picorn_render_svg
tools.description: Render your SVG through Picorn with real typography and optional image/icon placeholders. Returns an inline preview and public creationUrl.

tools.name: picorn_editor_import_image
tools.description: Import image bytes from any external or agent-native image generator into Picorn storage. Pass imageBase64 with or without a data: prefix, then use the returned imageUrl in one or more native image layers. This is the bridge for iterative generator → editor → render workflows.

tools.name: picorn_editor_create_project
tools.description: Create a persistent native Picorn editor project with one empty slide. This is the starting point for multi-layer and multi-slide work. Returns projectId, slideId, exact canvas dimensions, and the canonical /studio/editor?runId=... editorUrl that must be included in the final answer.

tools.name: picorn_editor_inspect_project
tools.description: Read the complete project, including every slide, layer, property, z-index, and latest rendered image URL.

tools.name: picorn_video_create_project
tools.description: Create a persistent video project with a real 30fps timeline, native layers, keyframes and a canonical /video/editor link.

tools.name: picorn_video_import_media
tools.description: Upload agent-owned MP4, WebM, MOV, MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A or OGG bytes into Picorn storage for use by video/audio timeline layers. Maximum 15 MB.

tools.name: picorn_editor_add_slide
tools.description: Add another slide to an editor project. Projects support up to 20 slides. Returns the new slide as an inline preview.

tools.name: picorn_editor_update_slide
tools.description: Change a slide background, semantic role, or image prompt. Returns the changed slide as an inline preview.

tools.name: picorn_editor_delete_slide
tools.description: Delete a slide and its layers. A project always keeps at least one slide.

tools.name: picorn_editor_add_layer
tools.description: Add a native editor layer. Supported types: text, image, shape, group, qr, video, audio. SVG uses an image layer with isSvg:true. Position is the layer CENTER in canvas pixels. The layer accepts the same persisted fields as /editor: transforms, opacity, blendMode, text styles/effects/rich text, imag

tools.name: picorn_editor_update_layer
tools.description: Patch any editable property on a layer: content, position, size, transform, style, filters, masks, effects, blend mode, visibility, lock state, SVG overrides, timing, audio, or keyframes. Returns the changed slide as an inline preview automatically.

tools.name: picorn_video_add_clip
tools.description: Add a video or audio clip to a Picorn timeline. Source URLs must use an approved public media host. Video positions are center coordinates; timing and trim values are frame-based.

tools.name: picorn_editor_delete_layers
tools.description: Delete one or more layers and clean their group references.

tools.name: picorn_editor_reorder_layers
tools.description: Set layer order. objectIds are bottom-to-top; omitted existing IDs retain their relative order on top.

tools.name: picorn_editor_group_layers
tools.description: Create the same metadata group used by the visual editor. Grouping preserves world positions and render output.

tools.name: picorn_editor_ungroup_layers
tools.description: Remove a group while preserving all child layers.

tools.name: picorn_editor_align_layers
tools.description: Align positioned layers to their shared left, center, right, top, middle, or bottom bound.

tools.name: picorn_editor_distribute_layers
tools.description: Evenly distribute three or more positioned layers horizontally or vertically.

tools.name: picorn_editor_duplicate_layer
tools.description: Duplicate a non-group layer, including all style, filter, effect, mask, and animation properties.

tools.name: picorn_editor_render_project
tools.description: Render selected or all slides through Picorn's real Fabric editor pipeline. Returns persistent public image URLs, creationUrl, and the canonical editorUrl that must be given to the user. Static renders include text, image/SVG, shape, group and QR layers; video/audio timing remains editable project d

tools.name: picorn_video_render_project
tools.description: Render the native timeline to a finished MP4/H.264 or WebM/VP9 file. The render includes multi-slide sequencing, timed layers, video frames, keyframe animation and mixed audio, and returns a public video URL plus /video/editor link.

tools.name: picorn_search_icons
tools.description: Search Picorn's vector icon library before composing a design.

tools.name: picorn_search_areas
tools.description: Find approved torn, wavy, blob, banner and other decorative shapes for a design.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: picorn_projects_inspect, picorn_editor_inspect_project · Private data: picorn_projects_create, picorn_projects_inspect, picorn_projects_update, picorn_video_render_project · Public sink: picorn_design_image, picorn_video_import_media · Destructive: picorn_editor_delete_slide, picorn_editor_delete_layers, picorn_editor_ungroup_layers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: picorn_projects_inspect, picorn_editor_inspect_project · Private data: picorn_projects_create, picorn_projects_inspect, picorn_projects_update, picorn_video_render_project · Public sink: picorn_design_image, picorn_video_import_media · Destructive: picorn_editor_delete_slide, picorn_editor_delete_layers, picorn_editor_ungroup_layers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
